# Portfolio Project - React 19 + TypeScript + SCSS

## Project Overview
Modern developer portfolio built with React 19, TypeScript, and SCSS featuring high-contrast design (black, white, gray, metallic blue) and advanced CSS/React effects.

## Technology Stack
- React 19
- Vite
- TypeScript
- SCSS/SASS
- Advanced CSS animations and effects

## Development Guidelines
- Use SCSS modules for component styling
- Implement React 19 features (transitions, suspense, server components concepts)
- Focus on visual design with advanced CSS effects
- High contrast color scheme: #000000, #FFFFFF, #808080, #4A90E2 (metallic blue)
- Use Lorem Ipsum for placeholder text where needed
